items.title: Biker Town
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Dive into the biker life today! Get on the road as one of the bikers, put in some time as a greasy mechanic, or don your apron and get to work at the bar! Whatever your choice there is a skin for you in Biker Town!

- 24 Unique skins
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Noob1234 Difficulty Mode
items.creator: Meatball Inc
items.description:
Life is easy on Noob1234 Difficulty Mode! Join the Preston universe and explore over 30 new game modifications. Spawn into Noob1234’s dirt mansion, start the stopwatch, and beat Minecraft at record speeds!

- 30+ modifications
- Single or multiplayer
- Custom car & pet
- Exploding dirt cannon
- Derpy mobs & textures
- Noob1234 Mansion

By CinemaCraft & PrestonPlayz

items.title: Parkour Co-op
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Take one friend into this unusual parkour, where good teamwork and perfect communication is crucial to get through. Try out this co-op parkour, with two identical parkour courses in which both players will need to cooperate to help the other go on.

- 6 sections with different parkour challenges
- Up to 2 players!
- Singleplayer and multiplayer mode!
- By Agora Studios

items.title: Vault Hunters
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
As the first cryopod test subject to be flash frozen into the future, you expected to come out the other side into a new and better world! But where did everyone go? You've been left stranded in the middle of nowhere! How will you survive?

- 3 fully explorable bunker bases
- Make the base your own!
- Hidden end portal

items.title: Modern Fashion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Have you been looking for something with a more modern appeal? Explore Minecraft with these 10 new modern teen skins that are sure to capture everyone's attention!

-10 fashionable teen skins
-Up-to-date, modern skins ready to play
-By pexchxs

items.title: Teen Fashion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Teen style is perfect year round. Grab your friends and look cute with these modern skins. Fashionable design and great colors will make you stand out in any Minecraft world.

- 12 skins

items.title: Lucky Block Hacker
items.creator: Doctor Benx
items.description:
Lucky Block - Hacker Edition! Conquer the jump & run to grab powerful gear! Test your skills in this thrilling parkour!

- OP enchantments
- Custom armor effects
- 40+ new craftable items
- PvP arena for up to 4 friends or a solo boss fight
- 100+ random outcomes

By Benx + oectway
items.changelog:
- Updatet to latest Minecraft-Version
- Fixed all known bugs

items.title: Birthday Party
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
All birthdays are special so let's throw a big party to celebrate your day! Call in the clown and light up the cake because this is one huge celebration! All of your friends and family are here just for you! That big pile of gifts is definitely a bonus!

- 16 birthday themed skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Parkour Squad
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Grab your friends and challenge each other to parkour obstacles. With these skins you and your friends can squad up and complete some parkour stages together!

- 13 parkour skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Techno Colors
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Colorful, check. Rainbow, check. Black, check. With these cool, colorful and dark skins what more could you want! Enjoy these skins as you party, roleplay, or just stand out in the crowd.

- 10 colorful skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Peaceful Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Peaceful Base has everything you need to kick back and play in style. Inspired by beautiful Asian architectural styles - you're sure to enjoy your time in the base.

+ Beautiful Asian-inspired buildings and trees!
+ Underground base with 3 floors!
+ Loot room with lots of resources to utilise
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Parkour Through Time
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Learn more about the world as you parkour through 100 different levels equivalent to 100 different events. With each level you get a fact about the time in which the level takes place. The parkour has several themes such as modern, space, medieval, sci-fi, pirates, dinosaurs and more!

+100 levels!
+Learn while playing!
+Easy and hard parkour!

items.title: Cloaked Mobs
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Have fun with these cool monsters and warriors and play awesome roleplay games!

- 11 unique cloaked mob skins
- An ultra badass look!
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Girls Streamers
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Girls Streamers are here, dear followers. Choose your lady and join the game as a beautiful, fashionable teen and make your way to the hype and billions of subscribers.

+ Teens fashion
+ By In Mine

items.title: Fashion Stars
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The fashion stars from your dream are finally here! Express yourself with these trendy teens and go explore the city of trends! Take the main stage and be the most stylish player in your favorite gamemodes such as skyblock and parkour!

-20 trendy skins
-1 free skin
-By inPixel

items.title: LUCKY BLOCK!
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Do you want to test your luck? Try it out here on LUCKY BLOCK! Play with your friends, explore a huge factory, gather over-powered gear and test your strength in the pvp arena! Own a lightning rod, rain diamonds, and many more!

+ 150x lucky block drops!
+ Random lucky and unlucky events!
+ Drops inspired from original lucky block mod!

! Only usable on the world provided.

items.title: Millionaire Mobs
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Check out these millionaire mobs, put them on and feel what a life full of luxury is like.

- Sixteen Millionaire Mobs.
- Two skins totally free.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Rainbow Party
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Here you have 10 wonderful skins to make your party colorful, unique and unforgettable.

- 10 rainbow party skins!
- 1 totally free skin!
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Professional Athletes
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
These athletes are professional, have many hours of training and have played in many championships; can you handle them? Put them on and you will find out!

- Twelve Professional Athletes.
- One skin totally free.
- By DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Diecies Skin Pack
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Get the skin merch pack for the YouTuber "DieciesYT". From Zombie to Agent Diecies, you can rock out like a famous gamer! 

+ 7 YouTuber skins

items.title: Demon Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
These demons sure know how to be stylish. They’re up to no good, and they want you to join them for the fun of it! Unleash your sinister side with a trendy modern teen style with our latest skin pack, Demon Teens!

- 12 teen skins!
- Perfect for roleplaying!

items.title: Anime Dragons
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description: Become one with the your inner dragon! Includes 11 anime dragon skins, perfect for any adventure you would like to take!

items.title: Zombie Siege: Metro
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Waves of zombies are breaching the underground metro! Join Artyom, Lydia, Timothy, and Sarah in the fight against the undead by buying doors and weapons while refueling the mega train. Experience this and more in the second edition of the Zombie Siege series.

+ 1-4 players
+ 100 Waves of increasing difficulty
+ Custom zombie models and environment textures
+ 4 skins

items.title: Zombie Siege: Bio Lab
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Waves of zombies are breaching the underground laboratory! Join Artyom, Lydia, Timothy, and Sarah in the fight against the undead by buying doors and weapons while in search of the exit. Experience this and more in the first edition of the Zombie Siege series.

+ 1-4 players
+ 60 waves of increasing difficulty
+ Custom zombie models and environment textures
+ 4 skins
